It is listed under 'Areas Removed from the Infected Area List between 10 and 16 January 1975 - CHOLERA - Africa - CHAD: N'Djamena Cap. (A); Chari-Baguirmi Prefecture'. Under the IHR (1969) an area is removed when the health administration notifies freedom from infection (Art. 7: for cholera at least twice the incubation period since the last case) or sends negative weekly reports (WER compilation criteria, cf. WER 68(10) 1993 p.72). So this is evidence that the 1974 epidemic had ENDED in N'Djamena and Chari-Baguirmi by early January 1975, not that cholera persisted into 1975. The last Chad notification was 22-28 Oct 1974, 3 cases/1 death (WER 50(1-2), meta 168, row 1447). The two presence records citing this source (N'Djamena and Chari-Baguirmi, 1975-01-03..1975-01-16) rest on the misreading and should be removed.
